steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Labelling: teachers attach labels to students based on assumptions about ability, behaviour and background. Becker: teachers have an 'ideal pupil' image (middle-class, well-behaved, motivated) and judge students against it. Raynor: teachers labelled students as 'bright' or 'difficult' based on appearance and behaviour, not ability. Labels become self-fulfilling prophecies (Rosenthal & Jacobson: Pygmalion in the Classroom). | Key Fact: Streaming and setting: ability grouping within schools. Streaming: broad ability groups across all subjects. Setting: ability groups within individual subjects.
